name: Animate Artifact — an animated Lander is still a Lander
notes: CR 205.1a: an artifact that becomes an artifact creature keeps its artifact types. Scryfall's artifact-type catalog lacked Lander, Mutagen, Heartwood and Vibranium, so on the site 71 cards erased them. The rules' lists are in data.js (officialSubtypes); tests/rules.py checks them.
